description: Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) configuration for hydrogen pathways

electrolysis_grid_ci.description: Carbon intensity (gCO2e/MJ) of electrolytic H2 produced from California grid electricity. Applied whenever electrolysis_electricity_source = grid; reflects the high emissions of CA grid power. Solar electrolysis keeps the renewable electrolysis pathway CI (0).

lcfs_parameters.description: EEI (Energy Economy Improvement) accounts for better fuel economy in hydrogen trucks. MJ per kg H2 is the energy content of hydrogen. Credit price in USD per credit.

hydrogen_pathways.description: Hydrogen production pathways with their carbon intensities (gCO2e/MJ)

pathways.name: Latest California Hydrogen Mix
pathways.description: The current weighted carbon intensity mix of all hydrogen available on the California market. 2025 average of quarterly LCFS values (Q1 47.89, Q2 49.88, Q3 -5.40, Q4 -7.45)

pathways.name: 100% Dairy Biomethane-SMR
pathways.description: Steam methane reforming using dairy biomethane

pathways.name: 33% Biomethane SMR
pathways.description: 33% biomethane blended with natural gas SMR

pathways.name: Natural Gas-SMR (Gaseous H2)
pathways.description: Natural gas steam methane reforming - gaseous storage

pathways.name: Natural Gas-SMR (Liquefied H2)
pathways.description: Natural gas steam methane reforming - liquefied storage

lcfs_price_schedule.description: LCFS credit price schedule. Can be used for predetermined prices per year.

lcfs_price_scenarios.description: Named LCFS credit price scenarios for figure scripts. Use load_lcfs_price_scenario(name) in config_defaults.jl.

lcfs_price_curve.description: Dynamic LCFS credit price calculation using start/end prices and curve type

production_facilities.description: Production facility costs and parameters by technology type

initial_production.note: Set CAPEX to 0 to treat as sunk cost, or specify value to include in production cost calculation

electrolysis_pricing.description: Parameters for electrolysis CAPEX-based production cost calculation

grid_electricity.description: Industrial grid electricity cost in USD per kWh. Grid connection cost is the one-time capital cost for grid connection infrastructure per kW of electrolyzer capacity.

solar_powered.description: Solar operating hours is the number of daylight hours per day the electrolyzer can operate (typical: 8-12). Solar capacity factor accounts for weather and panel efficiency. Typical range: 0.20-0.30

electrolysis_pricing.note: Electrolyzer capacity: (kg_day × 55 kWh/kg) / 24 hours. Each kg H2 requires 55 kWh.
